jobs.tierReason: autopilot starting paid runs (spend caps) and file writes
jobs.prompt: Safety review of Phase 10c. Files: tools/human-jobs.mjs, tools/inbox.mjs, tools/inbox-commands.mjs, tools/backlog.mjs, tools/notify.mjs, docs/plans/phase10c-design.md (the rules), and coordination/review/phase10c.diff (changes to swarm.mjs and autopilot.mjs). Check with evidence: (1) can autopilot start a deferred group or a backlog goal twice, without a spend cap (default $5/2M tokens must apply), from main/master or a dirty tree, or while a run is running; can a crash start the same work twice; (2) can a human job or backlog goal text forge journal events or run a command (notify: osascript argv, escaping); (3) file writes: symlinks under .swarm/project, atomic writes of human-jobs.json and backlog.json, id handling (path traversal in RUN:JOB, group ids); (4) can `swarm done` or `decide` close the wrong item, another project, or an already-closed one; can `inbox --all` read outside registered projects; (5) manifests with a human job: does any path skip validation of the blocked jobs (they are validated by validateManifest before lifting, and again when started), and can after-edges to a human job be lost. Report findings ranked high/medium/low with file and line.
